sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 10 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You made a good impression on some serious people. Now they expect results, so don't let them down! And yeah, of course there will be bets. I'll cut you in on the profits, don't worry. Just focus on your job: kill, earn money... and most importantly, make it look good!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Earn 1,500 objective score in CheckPoint mode
- Eliminate 20 enemies in CheckPoint mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +6,900 EXP
- 59,000 Roubles
- 20 GP coins
- Unlocks Kalashnikov AK-101 5.56x45 assault rifle in the Armory
